title: Studying cancer drug resistance using BRCA-deficient mouse mammary tumor organoids
protocol: Wash tumor material in 10 ml PBS in a 50 ml tube.
Spin at 1200 rpm for 3 min and remove the supernatant.
Add collagenase solution to dissected tumor pieces.
Incubate the mixture in a shaker at 37°C for 30 min.
Spin at 1500 rpm for 10 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 ml ADDF+++ with a BSA-coated pipette.
Spin at 1500 rpm for 10 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 4 ml DNAse solution.
Vortex for 3-5 minutes and then add 6 ml ADDF+++
Spin at 1500 rpm for 10 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 ml ADDF+++ with a BSA-coated pipette.
Filter the solution through a 70 um cell strainer into a BSA-coated 50 ml tube, then transfer to a BSA-coated 15 ml falcon tube.
Spin at 1500 rpm for 10 min.
Perform several differential centrifugations by aspirating the supernatant and resuspending the pellet in 10 ml ADDF+++ with a BSA-coated pipette.
Spin at 1500 rpm for 1 min.
Resuspend pellet in Cultrex Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Extract (BME) Type 2 mixed 1:1 with cold mouse mammary gland organoid medium (ENR medium).
Seed on 24-well suspension plates at 40 μl per well.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min until BME has solidified.
Add ENR medium at 0.5 ml per well.
Carefully aspirate media without disturbing BME-embedded organoids when changing the medium.
Place 2 ml cold ADDF+++ medium in a 15 ml tube on ice.
Take 1 ml using a P1000 pipette and use it to collect BME+organoids.
Pre-coat fire-polished glass Pasteur pipette with cold ADDF+++ medium before using it to disrupt organoids.
Add 6 ml cold ADDF+++ media to each tube and spin at 900 rpm for 5 min.
Remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in BME/ENR media mix.
Seed the resuspended organoids as described above.
Incubate at 37°C and add ENR medium.
Carefully aspirate media when using TrypLE to dissociate organoids.
Incubate at 37°C for 10 min.
Use a pre-coated fire-polished glass Pasteur pipette to disrupt organoids.
Add 4 ml cold ADDF+++ media to each tube.
Spin the tubes at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the tubes.
Resuspend the pellet in BME/ENR media mix and seed as described above.
Incubate at 37°C.
For long-term storage, mix organoid cultures with Recovery Cell Culture Freezing Medium.
Freeze organoids following standard procedures.
Thaw frozen organoids using standard thawing procedures.
Embed thawed organoids in BME and culture as described.
Carefully aspirate the media from organoids.
Disrupt organoids using TrypLE as described above.
Count the cell number.
Aliquot the cell suspension into tubes.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in viral suspension diluted in ENR supplemented with 8 μg/ml Polybrene.
Transfer the cell suspensions to a 24-well plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 600 g for 60 min at room temperature.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 6 h.
Transfer the cell suspensions into tubes.
Centrifuge at 1200 rpm for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in BME/ENR media mix and seed as described above.
The following day, add media supplemented with the appropriate antibiotic(s) for selection of transduced cells.
Use organoids at a size corresponding to an average of 150-200 cells per organoid.
Aspirate media without disturbing BME-embedded organoids.
Place 2 ml cold ADDF+++ medium in a 15 ml tube on ice.
Take 1 ml of the cold ADDF+++ medium using a P1000 pipette to collect BME+organoids.
Take a small aliquot, disrupt organoids using TrypLE as described above and determine cell number.
Extrapolate cell count to the organoid suspension.
Spin the suspension at 900 rpm for 5 minutes.
Resuspend appropriately in BME/ENR media mix: for KB1P(M) organoids – 10^4 cells/40 μl, for KB2P organoids – 5x10^4 cells/40 μl.
Inject 40 μl of the organoid suspension into the fourth mammary fat pad of recipient mice.
